I started the app’s free trial and canceled the subscription the same day, yet I was still charged $29.99. I never intended to purchase a subscription, and I feel completely misled and frustrated that I now have to pay just to download an app on my iPhone. I have read a lot of the reviews this typical of them to scam you!

reviews.text: This app says its basic option is free… but it’s not. Any plant you try to identify you get a message that the plant is sick (when it’s not!) and the app tries to force you to pay for a subscription to get any info. If you don’t upgrade to the paid option it deletes your photo and won’t ID the plant. Scam!

reviews.title: incredibly scammy, do not download
reviews.text: the app requires a subscription in order to be used, has different tiers and automatically signs you up for the $9.99 tier which is charged WEEKLY, not monthly. the app advertising itself as free on the app store but ultimately requiring a paid subscription in order to use it rather than just being a paid app upfront is incredibly disingenuous and feels scammy, i used this app once to identify a houseplant and forgot to cancel my free trial afterwards and was charged the full $10 for a “paid” subscription afterwards. reached out to customer service and received no reply. there are much better identification apps on the market that are absolutely free and not misleading.
